# Website Event SSR

- `src/Website/src/app/app.routes.server.ts` keeps `/evenement` and `/evenement/:id` in `RenderMode.Server`; `/evenement/:id/tableau` stays client-rendered for the live SSE board.
- `VpdEventsPageComponent` and `EventDetailComponent` fetch through `VpdEventsFacadeService`/Axios. Axios promises do not automatically keep Angular's server render stable, so initial HTML could contain the loading shell or omit the event detail.
- `shared/events/ssr-pending-task.ts` registers those requests with Angular `PendingTasks` only on the server. Completion releases the task; a 3-second limit releases it if the API stalls so SSR cannot wait forever.
- `AgendaCalendarComponent` previously rebuilt all three visible calendars from its template getter and recalculated every event-day animation delay for each matching button. It now caches available months, visible month cells and date delays, rebuilding when the event input or visible month changes.
- Specs cover server stability while event data is pending, the bounded task completion, and reuse of the calendar model during unchanged change detection.
- Local SSR smoke used the current 10-event API response through a local mock API: `/evenement` rendered the calendar and event names; the Halloween loto detail rendered its event title. A simultaneous batch of 20 list and 20 detail HTTP requests returned 200 for all 40; p95 was 4.75 s for the list and 6.28 s for detail. This validates SSR HTTP behavior only; it is not an SSE-client load run.
- Prior SSE load validation (recorded in the 2026-10-31 session; exact run date/time not retained) connected 300 clients to the deployed board page and SSE endpoint for 60 seconds on `vpd-web-ca-dev-fc` with its deployed API dev-fc revision. All 300 received the initial snapshot and four heartbeats; there were no errors or early closes. API peaked at two replicas, 17% CPU and 41% memory with no restarts; Website peaked at 1% CPU and 14% memory with no restarts. This run predates the current SSR correction and is a separate deployed environment result.
- Website ChromeHeadless passes 197/197, SEO HTTP checks pass 14/14, and the production SSR build succeeds with the pre-existing initial-bundle budget and CommonJS warnings. Graphify extracted 1,913 files, but its HTML view is above the 9,398-node limit.
- Keep the current SSR correction undeployed until its PR is reviewed. Do not conflate the local 40-request SSR HTTP run with the earlier deployed 300-client SSE run; this SSR change did not repeat SSE load testing.
